custom_field: প্রতি প্রশ্নের মান ১ ও ভুল উত্তরের জন্য ০.২৫ কাটা যাবে।

Bank-English.question:
১) Change the voice:
You must do your duties.
Bank-English.option1: Your duties must had done by you.
Bank-English.option2: Your duties must be done by you.
Bank-English.option3: Your duties must done by you.
Bank-English.option4: Your duties must have been done by you.
Bank-English.exp:
• Model Auxiliary Verb যুক্ত Active voice থেকে passive voice করার নিয়ম:
- Active voice এর object টি passive voice এর subject হয়।
- Tense অনুযায়ী auxiliary verb বসে।
- model Auxilary গুলোর সাথে be যুক্ত করে principle verb - এর past participle form বসাতে হয়। 
- preposition (by, with, at, to, in) বসে।
- Active voice এর subject টি passive voice এর object হয়।

- Model Auxiliary Verb যেমন - can, could, may, might, shall, should, will, would, must, need, ought to, going to ইত্যাদি। 

Active Voice: You must do your duties.
Passsive Voice: Your duties must be done by you.

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Bank-English.question: ২) Mostofa said, "Let the girl say whatever she likes." (Change the narration.)
Bank-English.option1: Mostofa said that the girl said whatever she liked.
Bank-English.option2: Mostofa told that the girl might say whatever she likes.
Bank-English.option3: Mostofa said that the girl might say whatever she liked.
Bank-English.option4: Mostofa said the girl might say whatever she likes.
Bank-English.exp:
- Mostofa said, "Let the girl say whatever she likes." 

- Imperative sentence এ let থাকলে, বাক্যটিকে narration পরিবর্তন করতে হলে,
- subject + reporting verb + object + that + reporting speech - এর subject + might + reported speech এর মূল verb - থেকে শেষ পর্যন্ত বসে।
- Mostofa said that the girl might say whatever she liked.

Bank-English.question: ৩) Sami gave me a pen. (Make it passive.)
Bank-English.option1: Sami gave a pen to me.
Bank-English.option2: I was given a pen by Sami.
Bank-English.option3: I was given pen by Sami.
Bank-English.option4: I had been given a pen by Sami.
Bank-English.exp:
• Double Object যুক্ত Active voice করতে হলে:
- যে কোন একটি object কে subject ধরে passive voice করা যায়।
- এক্ষেত্রে indirect object বা personal object টিকে subject করা অধিক শ্রেয়।
- তবে indirect object preposition যুক্ত হলে direct object - কে subject ধরতে হবে। 
- Active voice এর object টি passive voice এর subject হয়।
- Tense অনুযায়ী auxiliary verb বসে।
- তারপর মূল verb এর past participle হয়।
- দ্বিতীয় object টি বসবে।
- preposition (by, with, at, to, in) বসে।
- Active voice এর subject টি passive voice এর object হয়।

Active Voice: Sami gave me a pen.
Passive Voice: I was given a pen by Sami./A pen was given me by Sami.

Bank-English.question: ৪) Courage: Rashness :: ?
Bank-English.option1: Temperance : Modesty
Bank-English.option2: Mettle : Spirit
Bank-English.option3: Honor : Humility
Bank-English.option4: Generosity : Prodigality
Bank-English.exp:
• প্রশ্নে উল্লিখিত শব্দগুলোর অর্থ:
• Courage: Rashness ::
Courage - নির্ভীকতা।
Rashness - অসমীক্ষ্যকারি, হঠকারিতা।

• সঠিক উত্তরের শব্দগুলোর অর্থ:
• Generosity : Prodigality
Generosity - অকৃপণতা। 
Prodigality - অপব্যয়।

• Analogical Relation:
Courage যেমন Rashness এর বিপরীত একইভাবে Generosity, Prodigality এর বিপরীত। 

• অন্যান্য অপশন বিশ্লেষণ,
• Temperance : Modesty
Temperance - মাদকদ্রব্য-পরিহার।
Modesty - শিষ্টতা।

• Mettle : Spirit
Mettle - সাহস।
Spirit - আত্ম। 

• Honor : Humility
Honor - সম্মান। 
Humility - নম্রতা। 

সুতরাং, option বিশ্লেষণ করলে দেখা যায় যে, সঠিক analogy টি হচ্ছে - Courage: Rashness :: Generosity : Prodigality.

Bank-English.question: ৫) He hurt himself. (Change the voice.)
Bank-English.option1: He had hurt by himself.
Bank-English.option2: He was hurten by himself.
Bank-English.option3: He was hurt by himself.
Bank-English.option4: He was hurt.
Bank-English.exp:
• Reflexive Pronoun (myself, yourself, himself, herself, themselves, ourselves etc) যুক্ত active voice কে passive voice করতে হলে। 
- Active voice - এর subject অপরিবর্তিত থাকবে।
- Tense অনুযায়ী auxiliary verb বসে।
- তারপর মূল verb এর past participle হয়।
- preposition (by, with, at, to, in) বসে।
-  reflexive object টি বসে।।

Active Voice: He hurt himself.
Possive voice: He was hurt by himself.

Bank-English.question: ৬) Food : Nourish :: ?
Bank-English.option1: Organ : Secrete
Bank-English.option2: Fluids : Circulate
Bank-English.option3: Cells : Degenerate
Bank-English.option4: Antibiotics : Protect
Bank-English.exp:
• প্রশ্নে উল্লিখিত শব্দগুলোর অর্থ:
• Food : Nourish :: ?
Food - খাদ্য।
Nourish - পুষ্টিসাধন।

• সঠিক উত্তরের শব্দগুলোর অর্থ:
Antibiotics : Protect 
Antibiotics - জীবাণুনাশক। 
Protect - রক্ষণ।

• Analogical Relation:
- food দেশের norish করে, আর antibiotics, দেহের জীবাণু protect করে।

অন্যান্য অপশন বিশ্লেষণ,
• Organ : Secrete
Organ - দেহযন্ত্র।
Secrete - নিঃসরণ।

• Fluids : Circulate
Fluids - তরল পদার্থ।
Circulate -  ছড়িয়ে দেওয়া।

• Cells : Degenerate
Cells - দেহকোষ।
Degenerate - পর্যবসিত।

• Antibiotics : Protect 
Antibiotics -  জীবাণু-প্রতিরোধী পদার্থ।
Protect - রক্ষা করা।

সুতরাং, option বিশ্লেষণ করলে দেখা যায় যে, সঠিক analogy টি হচ্ছে - Food : Nourish :: Antibiotics : Protect.

Bank-English.question: ৭) Submit your task. (Change the voice.)
Bank-English.option1: Let your task had been submitted.
Bank-English.option2: Let your task be submit.
Bank-English.option3: Let your task be submitted.
Bank-English.option4: Let your task had submitted.
Bank-English.exp:
• Imperative Sentence - এ প্রদত্ত active voice কে passive voice - এ পরিবর্তন করতে হলে - 
- প্রথম let বসে
- Active voice এর object টি passive voice এর subject হয়।
- Tense অনুযায়ী auxiliary verb বসে।
- be বসে।
- তারপর মূল verb এর past participle হয়।
- Active voice এর subject টি passive voice এর object হয়।

Active Voice: Submit your task.
Passive Voice: Let your task be submitted.

Bank-English.question: ৮) Choose the correct spelling:
Bank-English.option1: Scripher
Bank-English.option2: Skripture
Bank-English.option3: Scripture
Bank-English.option4: Scriptur
Bank-English.exp:
• The correct spelling is 'Scripture'.

• Scripture (Noun)

Example Sentences:

Bank-English.question: ৯) Who taught you typing? (Change the voice.)
Bank-English.option1: By whom you have taught typing?
Bank-English.option2: By whom have you taught typing?
Bank-English.option3: By whom you taught typing?
Bank-English.option4: By whom were you taught typing?
Bank-English.exp:
• Active Voice-এ Who থাকলে passive voice করার নিয়ম:
- passive voice-টি 'By whom' দিয়ে আরম্ভ হবে।
- Tense অনুযায়ী auxiliary verb বসে।
- Object টি subject  হিসেবে বসবে।
- অনেক সময় tense অনুযায়ী be/being/been বসে।
- মূল verb এর past participle বসে।

Active voice: Who taught you typing?
Passive voice: By whom were you taught typing?

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Bank-English.question:
১০) Choose the correct indirect speech of the following direct speech:
He said, "We are all sinners."
Bank-English.option1: He said that all of them were sinners.
Bank-English.option2: All of us are sinners was told by him.
Bank-English.option3: He said that they were sinners.
Bank-English.option4: He said that we are all sinners.
Bank-English.exp:
• Direct Narration: He said, "We are all sinners."
- এটি চিরন্তন সত্য যুক্ত বাক্য। 

• Narration এর ক্ষেত্রে,
- Direct narration টি universal truth বা চিরন্তন সত্য বা habitual fact এর হলে,
- Direct speech থেকে Indirect speech এ রূপান্তরের বেলায়: 
- Reporting verb এর subject বসে।
- reporting verb যা আছে তাই বসে। 
- Inverted comma উঠে that বসে। 
- reported speech এর কোন পরিবর্তন হয় না।

- Indirect Narration: He said that we are all sinners.

Bank-English.question:
১১) Change the voice of the following sentence:
Plumeria smells sweet.
Bank-English.option1: Plumeria is sweet when it smells.
Bank-English.option2: Plumeria is sweet when it is smelled.
Bank-English.option3: Plumeria is sweet when it is being smelled.
Bank-English.option4: Plumeria is sweet when it smelled.
Bank-English.exp:
Quasi-Passive active Voice থেকে passive voice করার নিয়ম:
- Active voice এর subject টি passive voice এর subject হয়।
- Tense অনুযায়ী auxiliary verb বসে।
- Adjective টি বসে।
- when বসে।
- it/they প্রথম subject অনুযায়ী বসে। 
- Tense অনুযায়ী auxiliary verb বসে।
- তারপর মূল verb এর past participle হয়।

Active voice: Plumeria smells sweet.
Passive voice: Plumeria is sweet when it is smelled.

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Bank-English.question: ১২) Change the Narration: My friend said to me, "May you pass the pen to her."
Bank-English.option1: My friend prayed me I might pass the pen to her.
Bank-English.option2: My friend hoped that I might pass the pen to her.
Bank-English.option3: My friend wished me I might pass the pen to her.
Bank-English.option4: My friend wished that I might pass the pen to her.
Bank-English.exp:
• Direct Narration: My friend said to me, "May you pass the pen to her."

• Narration এর ক্ষেত্রে,
- Direct narration টি Optative sentence এর হলে,
- Direct speech থেকে Indirect speech এ রূপান্তরের ক্ষেত্রে: 
- Reporting verb এর subject বসে।
- wish/pray বসে। 
- Inverted comma উঠে that বসে। 
- reported speech এর subject বসে, may/might বসে।
- মূল verb থেকে শেষ পর্যন্ত অংশ বসে।  

Indirect Narration: My friend wished that I might pass the pen to her.

Bank-English.question: ১৩) Make it passive: We should not laugh at a poor man.
Bank-English.option1: A poor man should not be laughed by us.
Bank-English.option2: A poor man should not be laughed at by us.
Bank-English.option3: A poor man should not be laughed us.
Bank-English.option4: A poor man should not laugh at by us.
Bank-English.exp:
• Correct Answer: A poor man should not be laughed at by us.

- “Laugh at” একটি group verb (intransitive + preposition), তাই Passive Voice-এ preposition ‘at’ বাদ দেওয়া যাবে না।

• Intransitive Verb যুক্ত Active voice থেকে passive voice করার নিয়ম:
- Active voice এর object টি passive voice এর subject হয়।
- Tense অনুযায়ী auxiliary verb বসে।
- তারপর মূল verb এর past participle হয়। অথবা,
- model Auxilary থাকলে তার সাথে be যুক্ত করে principle verb - এর past participle form বসাতে হয়। 
- preposition (by, with, at, to, in) বসে।
- Active voice এর subject টি passive voice এর object হয়।

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Bank-English.question:
১৪) The jurist went on arguing nonetheless.
What is the meaning of 'nonetheless'?
Bank-English.option1: In spite of everything
Bank-English.option2: Just in case
Bank-English.option3: Just as much
Bank-English.option4: Regardless of the consequences
Bank-English.exp:
• nonetheless:
- English Meaning: in spite of what has just been said : nevertheless.
- Bangla Meaning: তবু; অথচ।

Example Sentences: 
- They may not need you, but you have to be there nonetheless.
- Bacall nonetheless seemed and still seems to have been made for the screen.

Given Options:
• In spite of everything - সবকিছুর পরেও,
• Just in case - প্রয়োজনে, হঠাৎ কোনো পরিস্থিতির জন্য প্রস্তুত হিসেবে,
• Just as much - সমানভাবে, ঠিক এতটাই,
• Regardless of the consequences - ফলাফল ভেবেচিন্তে না, যতই হোক না কেন।

- Among the given options, 'In spite of everything' is the correct answer.

Bank-English.question:
১৫) Change the voice of the sentence:
I saw him cross the road.
Bank-English.option1: He was seen cross the road.
Bank-English.option2: He is seen to cross the road.
Bank-English.option3: He was seen to cross the road.
Bank-English.option4: He was seen crossing the road.
Bank-English.exp:
Active Voice: I saw him cross the road.
- see হলো verb of perception.

- এক্ষেত্রে, Active Voice-এ: bare infinitive রয়েছে।

• Active voice থেকে passive voice করার নিয়ম:
- Active voice এর object টি passive voice এর subject হয়।
- Tense অনুযায়ী auxiliary verb বসে।
- তারপর মূল verb এর past participle হয়।
- (to + infinitive বসে।)
- Active voice এর subject টি passive voice এর object হয়।

Passive voice: He was seen to cross the road.

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Bank-English.question: ১৬) He said, "Alas! Inflation is rising rapidly with the ongoing dollar crisis."
Bank-English.option1: He exclaimed with sorrow that inflation was rising rapidly with the ongoing dollar crisis.
Bank-English.option2: He exclaimed with sorrow that inflation is rising rapidly with the ongoing dollar crisis.
Bank-English.option3: He exclaimed with sorrow inflation was rising rapidly with ongoing crisis.
Bank-English.option4: He exclaimed that inflation had been rising rapidly with ongoing dollar crisis.
Bank-English.exp:
- Direct Narration: He said, "Alas! Inflation is rising with the ongoing dollar crisis."

• Narration এর ক্ষেত্রে,
- Direct narration টি Exclamatory sentence এর হলে,
- Direct speech থেকে Indirect speech এ রূপান্তরের ক্ষেত্রে: 
- Reporting verb এর subject বসে।
- exclaimed with joy/exclaimed with sorrow বসে। 
- Inverted comma উঠে that বসে। 
- reported speech এর subject বসে।
- Direct speech এর Tense- Indirect speech এ পরিবর্তন হয়। 
- Adjective বসবে।
- বাকি অংশ বসবে।  

- Indirect Narration: He exclaimed with sorrow that inflation was rising rapidly with the ongoing dollar crisis.

Bank-English.question:
১৭) We went to see the launching of the ship.
Change the voice -
Bank-English.option1: We went seeing the ship launched.
Bank-English.option2: We went seeing the ship being launched.
Bank-English.option3: We went to see the ship launched.
Bank-English.option4: We went to see the ship being launched.
Bank-English.exp:
Active Voice: We went to see the launching of the ship.
- এখানে, article + verbal noun (launching of) + object (the ship). 

• Verbal noun যুক্ত Active voice থেকে passive voice করার নিয়ম:
- verbal noun এর আগ পর্যন্ত অপরিবর্তিত থাকবে।
- Active voice এর object টি বসবে।
- Tense অনুযায়ী auxiliary verb বসে।
- তারপর মূল verb এর past participle হয়।

Passive Voice: We went to see the ship being launched.

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Bank-English.question: ১৮) What is the meaning of the phrase, 'at large'-
Bank-English.option1: Disorder
Bank-English.option2: Often
Bank-English.option3: Free
Bank-English.option4: Vast

Bank-English.question:
১৯) Change the given sentence from direct to indirect speech: 
Sayka said to her sister, "Will you go there?"
Bank-English.option1: Sayka told her sister if she will go there.
Bank-English.option2: Sayka asked her sister if she would go there.
Bank-English.option3: Sayqa asks her sister if she would go there.
Bank-English.option4: Sayqa asked her sister if she will go there.
Bank-English.exp:
Direct Narration: Sayka said to her sister, "Will you go there?"

• Narration এর ক্ষেত্রে,
- Direct narration টি interrogative sentence এর হলে,
- Direct speech থেকে Indirect speech এ রূপান্তরের ক্ষেত্রে: 
- Reporting verb এর subject বসে। 
- Reporting verb say/said, tell/told (যদি থাকে) বসে পরিবর্তিত হয়ে tense অনুযায়ী ask/asked বসে ।
- Inverted comma উঠে if বসে। 
- reported speech এর subject বসে।
- Direct speech এর Tense- Indirect speech এ পরিবর্তন হয়।

- তাই, সঠিক indirect narration হবে Sayka asked her sister if she would go there.

Bank-English.question: ২০) What is the synonym of the word 'merciless'?
Bank-English.option1: Atrocious
Bank-English.option2: Compassionate
Bank-English.option3: Vague
Bank-English.option4: Covert
Bank-English.exp:
• Merciless (adjective)
- English Meaning: having or showing no mercy.
- Bangla Meaning: ক্ষমাহীন; নির্দয়; নির্মম। 

Given Options:
Atrocious - নৃশংস।
Compassionate - পরদুঃখকাতর।
Vague - ভাসাভাসা।
Covert - ঝোপঝাড়।

Source: Merriam-Webster Dictionary, Accessible Dictionary, Cambridge Dictionary, live MCQ lecture.
